name: Nova Editor
author: 3dthc
summary: An editor and librarian for the Novation MiniNova as a native plugin, with its own MPC screen skin: every control maps to a MiniNova CC/NRPN, controls follow the synth, banks A-C and imported .syx files live on the SD card. Also a SysEx librarian for any other synth. With nova-audio loaded, the MiniNova plays on the plugin's own track.
